patterns.note: Dominant use of a single-column layout for primary text blocks, creating a strong vertical flow and ample negative space around content.
The homepage hero features extremely large, bold sans-serif typography as the primary visual element, setting an editorial and confident tone.
A stark monochrome palette of black text on a white background is used throughout, with color introduced only through project imagery.
A minimal header containing the site logo and a hamburger menu icon remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, without any visual transformation.
Project and journal entries are presented in a flexible grid layout, typically two columns on wider screens, with a consistent image-title-date structure.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport during scroll, without any size or background changes. Content scrolls underneath this static header.

Large, bold sans-serif text is used to create a strong visual hierarchy for the main hero statement, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and a distinct serif font for section headings.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif hero (~4-5x body) with clean sans-serif body text and distinct serif headings for sections (~1.5x body).
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced grid for content listings.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extremely large, bold, sans-serif hero typography that acts as the primary visual anchor, combined with an almost invisible, minimal navigation. This creates an immediate, confident, and editorial impression, prioritizing content and a clean aesthetic over complex UI elements.
